description: Enqueue an asynchronous inference job on an existing serverless endpoint and return a job handle. Use when the user wants inference from a model already deployed; create the endpoint first if there is none. Bills per million tokens processed. Not idempotent — calling it twice enqueues two jobs and bills for both, so do not retry a call whose outcome you did not see. Call it with confirm:false (the default) first: that previews the endpoint the job would run on, and runs nothing, and changes nothing. Then call again with confirm:true to act.

confirm.description: false (the default) previews and changes nothing; true acts

name: run_serverless_job
title: Run inference job
